name: NeuroSave – Smart Auto-Save
author: Ashar

sections.description:
NeuroSave is a powerful, user-friendly plugin that automatically saves text input and restores it after accidental refresh, crashes, or lost connections. Includes cross-session sync, plugin integrations, admin controls, and more.

Features

🧠 Free Features:
* Auto-save for all <input> and <textarea> fields
* Restore drafts automatically after refresh
* Works across posts, pages, custom post types
* Shows clear notifications (saved/restored)
* No config needed — just activate

🚀 Pro Features:
* Admin settings to enable/disable on specific post types or URLs
* Auto-clear expired drafts after X days
* Integrations: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, WooCommerce, bbPress
* Cross-session sync for logged-in users (via REST API)
* Admin draft viewer UI (view/delete saved drafts per field)
* Modular architecture, extendable via hooks
sections.installation:
1. Upload neurosave to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.

short_description: Smart client-side + server-side auto-saving of any form input or comment field. Prevent data loss. Restore across pages or sessions.
